name: peppered-chef-enter-sacrifices-an-ally-for-plus-two-power

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may sacrifice another ally. If you do, Peppered Chef gets +2 [POWER] until end of turn.

notes: Regression: the Chef was tagged through its pre-sacrifice mz id, which pointed at an empty slot after the field compacted, so it never got the +2 POWER.
